notes:
New Features:

- Settings now use separate 2 h Site Channels Check and 2 h IPTV Check tabs. The IPTV tab reads the current m3u4u group order dynamically and combines the final two groups into one selectable block.
- OXAX now exposes six visible channel Pages matching the long-check split: 6/6/6/6/7 channels followed by the final 10 FAP TV channels.

Improvements:

- The IPTV long-check queue now follows the exact m3u4u channel order of the selected group. Starting Auto Check from a later channel rotates the queue and checks the earlier channels after reaching the end.
- Settings keyboard/remote navigation is restored across tabs, buttons and selectable controls.
- Release Notes preserve the source wording, heading order and additional GitHub sections instead of forcing everything into three fixed sections.

Bugfixes:

- All available Sites is once again the guaranteed fallback selection in Channel Status, while individual Site selections can replace it without leaving an empty check scope.
- The three-failed-check option is committed before manual Channel Status checks, so it works independently even when Auto Check is disabled.
- Site/Page/Time/Group selections no longer use the unsupported checkmark glyph; selected buttons use the same light-red highlight style as active Settings tabs.
